newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares gain, Ukio bank leads. [CORRECTED 13:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares gain, Ukio bank leads. [CORRECTED 13:20 GMT]

text.p: Lithuanian shares continued to rise on Tuesday especially in Ukio bank which was the most traded stock, the Lithuanian National Stock Exchange said.
Overall central market volume was 158,317 litas and the group A index rose by a sizeable 72.14 points to 1660.68.
The group A index tracks the 35 most active listings on the bourse.
"Share offerings were low on New Year's Eve and the index will return to the average level after the holidays," Suprema dealers commented.

Ukio bank was active on turnover of 49,426 litas, while Hermis Bank showed the biggest price leap to 206,4 litas from 172 on low turnover of 2,479 litas (corrects Ukio bank was active and rose 19.01 litas from 18.5 litas on turnover of 2,479 litas).
Lithuanian Gas rose to 1.3 litas from 1.2 litas on trade of 17,326 litas.
Bizai Milk dairy went up to 8.2 litas against 8.0 litas, turning over 16,400 litas.
Block trades on Tuesday reached 1,264,971 litas and Metalu Komercija company registered business of 1,260,000 litas with a price of 1.05 litas.
The secondary government securities market was 127,233 litas.
